All finite matrix identities and contact separations were checked by the embedded executable from its actual file path; no finite test is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first globally unresolved six-disk perimeter size admits a rigorously identified isolated local minimum with full ambient perturbation control and the exact sharp response to every active contact opening. This is stronger and more useful than a stationary configuration or a restricted fixed-graph calculation, and the unique central-five-spoke optimizer supplies a natural complete class boundary. The general six-disk global problem is expressly not claimed.
